_README: Spec SITE-03. Route to opaque sentinel token, written by scripts/seed_member_pages.py and read by scripts/member-content-gate.mjs. The tokens carry no prose, so publishing them in a public repo leaks nothing; finding one of them in dist/ or src/ means member content has been pasted into a public artifact. A member node with no entry here fails the build: its body has never been checked.
